proposition: Nafsat I says the first of the two statements was a creed of adherence to the Sunna and Jamāʿa, delivered before the leading religious scholars at court and testified to by them, offered as leaving no opening to doubt his orthodoxy. Whether this statement is the R. Iʿtiqādāt is not said on these pages.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to the ruler who was judging him
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
